evidence: io.lisp:1289-1291 fnn-log-writer-stop clears *fnn-log-queue-head* after the join; if the writer died inside fnn-log-sink-accept (no handler) a queued (:swap . fd) is dropped with no close and no debt. operator-live.lisp:166-170 escalates through fn-ort-log-close-exit only (when run-code ...); when the run escapes with an error the held/uncertain settlement is a returned value, so the exit code comes from the primary alone (authority is retained in *fnn-owner-retained-service*; reachability of this second case not verified). The unbounded :swap queue push at io.lisp:1301 is r72-F7.
fix: Writer stop closes any queued swap fd through the log close ledger; escalate the settlement on the escape path too.
title: Log writer stop drops a queued swap fd if the writer thread died abnormally, and the operator run escalation of the final log settlement is skipped when the run escapes
